leo2a5dk.name: Leopard 2A5 DK
leo2a5dk.authority: Main ruled the Denmark line on 2026-10-29 (about 12:50, DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("add a bunch more denmark tanks"): Leopard 2A5 DK at tier IX, a photo-class first-party build with its Danish kit; no registered 3D comparison exists for this configuration. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
leo2a5dk.envelopeBasis: Width is the as-built X extent over the hull's rear bar-armour cages (the published Leopard 2A5 is 3.75 m over the skirts; the Helmand cages stand outboard of them). Length is the as-built Z extent: the 2A5's 9.97 m with the gun forward plus the stern cage 0.35 m off the louvres. Tallest is the whip tips as built. The bar armour and the drum commander's sight follow the US Army's Grafenwöhr photographs of 3-4 July 2014 (public domain, Wikimedia Commons).
